The Philosophy of Owning Your AI¶

Why Local-First AI?¶

  • Personal AI will make Personal Computers actually personal (again).
  • This echoes the 1970s homebrew computer era, when we built our own systems due to a lack of choices.
  • Comparing the bespoke nature of Web1 and repersonalization of Web3 to the big tech hegemony of Web2.
  • Why open-source software (OSS) and "free as in freedom" are crucial to owning your AI.

Understanding the Technology¶

What is an LLM?¶

  • LLMs are pure functions in software systems which are otherwise pretty much just ordinary applications.
  • They solve the incredibly difficult problem of understanding and using human language.
  • They are computationally expensive.
  • There are wide variations in performance with big factors including size, training data & method, and inference algorithm.

Analogies for AI¶

How do we think about AI?¶

  • The Electricity Analogy: Andrew Ng: "AI is the new electricity"

And we're not in the 1880s yet, we're much much closer to the mid/late 1700s (Lyden Jar) and early 1800s (Voltaic Pile).

https://library.si.edu/exhibition/fantastic-worlds/body-electric

Analogies for AI¶

  • Car Ownership

  • Owning an AI is like owning a car.

  • The CPU & GPU are engine and turbo. An agent harness is a chassis. This can go on for dashboard, windows, body, etc.

  • But an AI isn't a car

  • It is, or can be, a riding mechanic and tools for modifying the car, and even a car factory too. https://connorskelly.substack.com/p/building-plane-while-flying-burnout

Tools and Solutions¶

Toolset Overview¶

  • Local Applications: Jan.ai (Mac, Win, Linux), LMStudio.ai (Mac, Win, Linux), and Osaurus.ai (Mac).
  • Browser & Server Tools: WebLLM, Home Assistant, and the Wiki3.ai Web Proxy / IPFS Model Server.

Solving the RAG Problem¶

Adding Document Intelligence to Jan.ai¶

  • The Problem: Jan.ai does not support built-in RAG, meaning you can't drop a folder of PDFs into it to ask questions directly.
  • The Solution: Layer Jan.ai as a clean, privacy-first UI over Haystack and Open WebUI.
  • Haystack indexes documents locally, and Open WebUI provides RAG via an OpenAI-compatible API to connect with Jan.ai, keeping all data on your machine.

Setup & Configuration¶
